system.longDesc:
A strand of monofilament extending up the three meters, with a small weight at the end to control its swing and a handle the filament can retract into when not in use. A monofilament whip (or simply “mono-whip”) is a nearly invisible, razor-sharp flexible weapon. Its wielder can perform the Precise Force stunt for 1 SP rather than 2 and, if they choose to spend 2 SP on the stunt, ignore all the target’s armor rating from equipment. The wielder can also perform the Lightning Attack stunt for 1 SP rather than 2 and can perform the stunt multiple times, until one of the attacks misses. Wielding a mono-whip is dangerous, however.
